# Architecture Blueprint Summary

This document summarizes the generated architecture blueprint and metadata from the JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1 audit phase.

## Current System Architecture State
The system has been analyzed and the findings are documented in the `.jules/` directory:
- `.jules/codebase-dna.json`: Contains the repository profile and core DNA.
- `.jules/revolution-plan.json`: The deterministic execution blueprint for the next phase.
- `.jules/architecture-matrix.md`: A detailed tabular view of all current routes and their targeted updates.

We adhere to the Swiss Light Mode design doctrine, ZERO-NEW-ROUTES invariant, and hypermodern Next.js 16+ specifications.
